Subject: Post-session: ClearWave POC lab recap + actions (Apr 18)

Hi Tom / Sally — thanks again for running the session with us this morning. Quick recap and action items below. Attachments: meeting_recording_2028-04-18.mp4, load_test_results_0418.csv (summary), load_test_config_v2.yaml, poc_runbook_v1.pdf. Drive: https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/clearwave-poc-0418

What we accomplished
- Prompt review: validated 24 core prompts and standardized tokenization rules. Adjusted a few prompts to reduce repetition (see runbook notes).
- Routing: exercised region fallback and model-variant fallback. We observed correct fallback to redwood-red-7B-quant when capacity constrained.
- Load tests: executed steady 100 concurrent sessions (3-turn avg). Observations:
  - Avg latency (1st token): ~320ms
  - P95 latency: ~540ms
  - P99 latency: ~820ms (spike during one burst due to a routing misconfig — root cause below)

Key issues and quick fixes
- Routing misconfig: one rule prioritized model A over regional affinity which caused an expensive cross-region hop for ~7% of requests. Marcus patched policy to respect region affinity first; re-run shows removal of cross-region spikes.
- Tokenization variance: two prompts used legacy spacing; we added normalization step in the runbook.

Action items (owner — ETA)
- Marcus: finalize and commit load_test_config_v2.yaml + S3 results link (done) — ETA: 2028-04-18 EOD.
- Dev Patel: validate p99 tail for redwood-red-7B-quant under 120 concurrent and report recommended quantization knobs — ETA: 2028-04-24.
- Laura Bennett (Solutions): update prompt library with normalized prompts and add acceptance tests to the runbook — ETA: 2028-04-22.
- Kimberly: schedule follow-up focused on rollout & SLA guardrails (30–45 min) and share agenda — ETA: propose by 2028-04-20.

Next session proposal
- Goal: rollout plan and SLA guardrails, plus one targeted re-run of the problematic rule. Suggested: Tue Apr 24, 10:00–10:45 PT. Please confirm availability.

Notes and artifacts
- Recording: meeting_recording_2028-04-18.mp4 (attached)
- Results CSV: load_test_results_0418.csv (attached)
- Runbook: poc_runbook_v1.pdf (attached, updated lines marked)

If anything is missing or you want a deeper look into the traces, we can pull a separate trace export. Thanks again — felt like great alignment.

Best,
Kimberly Park
